stories.headline: The Download: a humanoid cleans house and Samsung builds for the AI boom
stories.dek: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future. —Grace Huckins When I saw an X post about a new humanoid-robot cleaning service

stories.headline: The Cybertruck’s Death Is Actually Great News for EVs
stories.dek: Tesla’s biggest failure is the second massive EV to get the axe within the last year, while smaller vehicles are proliferating. It could be a huge benefit for the US battery supply chain.

stories.headline: From the front row to the hot seat — what the midterms mean for Big Tech
stories.dek: After spending two years getting cozy with the White House, Big Tech is suddenly trying to make friends with Democrats, and the open question is whether that image makeover can hold up against what states, local communities, and the markets are about to do.
